goal: Refactor plugins/immune-brain/runtime/kernel/enrollment.ts so runEnrollmentRehearsal and enrollCanaryTask use one private definition of their shared capability, owner-state, Intent, and Git HEAD precondition checks while preserving both public signatures and all observable behavior. Rehearsal must remain report-only, perform zero authority writes, and never consume its capability. Real enrollment must preserve first-blocker failure ordering, final-lock freshness, and capability consumption immediately before the existing atomic enrollment commit. The implementation must not alter CAS locking, persisted schemas, capability semantics, host UX, or existing tests. Same-state-machine sibling files are review-only reference owners; any required mutation outside enrollment.ts requires Planner revision.

acceptance.assertion: Both public enrollment functions retain their signatures and observable results while routing the duplicated precondition definitions through one private implementation.
runEnrollmentRehearsal reports readiness blockers with zero authority writes and without consuming the capability.
enrollCanaryTask rejects the first blocking precondition before writes, preserves final-lock freshness, and consumes authority only immediately before atomic commit.
